market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL trades around $103-109 with the Strait of Hormuz blockade ongoing. To hit a settlement of $115+ by end of June requires another ~12% from recent highs. With Iran-US deadlocked and supply at ~70%+ disruption, a further escalation easily prints $115. But normalization paths exist too. Roughly 50-60%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Iran-US negotiations actually de-escalate or whether the blockade tightens further.
